requirements.title: AI Engineer
requirements.mandatory: 3+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering
requirements.requirements:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in CS, AI, or related field
Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.)
Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or model fine-tuning
Familiarity with MLOps and deployment pipelines
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, etc.)
Strong understanding of data preprocessing and feature engineering
Experience with Git / version control
Strong communication skills
requirements.requirements_block:
1. [MANDATORY] 3+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering
2. Bachelor's or Master's degree in CS, AI, or related field
3. Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.)
4. Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or model fine-tuning
5. Familiarity with MLOps and deployment pipelines
6. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, etc.)
7. Strong understanding of data preprocessing and feature engineering
8. Experience with Git / version control
9. Strong communication skills

decision.title: AI Engineer
decision.name: Alex Carter
decision.summary: Alex Carter has strong backend and cloud experience but lacks any evidence of AI/ML engineering or related skills. The candidate does not meet the mandatory requirement for AI/ML experience.
decision.strengths:
Strong background in backend and cloud infrastructure.
Proficient in Python and Git.
Demonstrated leadership and communication skills.
decision.concerns:
No evidence of AI/ML engineering experience.
No mention of ML frameworks, LLMs, or data preprocessing/feature engineering.
Cloud experience is not specific to AI/ML services.
decision.email_subject: Your AI Engineer application at SmartHire
decision.email_body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for your interest in the AI Engineer position at SmartHire and for the time you spent on your application. After careful review, we have decided not to move forward with your application for this role, as other candidates more closely match its current requirements.

We appreciate your interest in SmartHire and wish you every success in your search.

Best regards,
SmartHire Recruiting Team
